title: Create src/commands/feature.ts with Commander subcommand
description: Register the 'feature' subcommand with Commander. Accept optional positional description argument. Register --no-questions, --dry-run, and --backend flags. If no description, show interactive text input prompt.
acceptanceCriteria: rocket feature --help prints usage with all three flags
rocket feature (no args) shows an interactive prompt for the description

steps.details: Create src/commands/feature.ts. Export: async function featureCommand(description: string | undefined, options: { questions?: boolean; dryRun?: boolean; backend?: string }): Promise<void> { console.log('feature command', description, options) }

In src/cli.ts, add: program.command('feature [description]').description('Generate a feature spec and tasks from a natural language description').option('--no-questions', 'Skip clarification questions').option('--dry-run', 'Preview changes without writing files').option('--backend <name>', 'AI backend to use (copilot | claude | docker)').action(featureCommand)

steps.description: Add interactive prompt when description is not provided
steps.details: In featureCommand, if description is undefined: render an Ink TextInput prompt to collect the feature description. Only proceed after the user submits.
Run `npm run dev -- feature --help` and confirm all three flags are shown. Run `npm run dev -- feature 'test feature'` and confirm it doesn't crash.

technicalNotes: Commander's --no-questions uses the negated flag pattern — options.questions is true by default, false when --no-questions is passed
